draw.cip.found: Status of the CIP descriptors tab of the Drawing; {n} = number of R/S and E/Z labels found.
draw.cip.fail: Status of the CIP descriptors tab when the calculation fails; {message} = the error.
draw.cip.atom: Row of a stereogenic center; {atom} = symbol and number of the atom (C2), {label} = R or S.
draw.cip.atomLow: Row of a pseudoasymmetric center; {atom} = symbol and number of the atom, {label} = lowercase r or s.
draw.cip.bond: Row of a double bond; {a} and {b} = the two atoms (C4, C5), {label} = E or Z.
